OrbitControls
-------------
`OrbitControls.js` is the Three.js examples control implementation and is
included under the same Three.js MIT terms. Its source file has no standalone
license header in this snapshot; this notice supplies the attribution without
modifying the vendor file.

Playwright (development-only provenance)
-----------------------------------------
The original GLM app records Playwright as a development dependency for browser
checks. `node_modules` and package-manager caches are not included in this
release. No Playwright code is redistributed here; consult the package's
upstream Apache-2.0 license and NOTICE when reproducing those checks.

The app package metadata and any accompanying project notices govern licensing
of the original educational source. This third-party notice supplies vendor
attribution only and does not relicense upstream or original code.
